rules.name: Hardcoded credential
rules.description: A credential is committed to the repository in config or source.

rules.name: Credential accepted as tool input
rules.description: A tool takes a secret as a parameter, routing it through the LLM context window.

rules.name: Capability exceeds declared scope
rules.description: Code exercises a capability the manifest never declared a scope for.

rules.name: No scopes declared
rules.description: A manifest exposes tools without declaring any authorization scopes.

rules.name: Unconstrained input reaches a dangerous sink
rules.description: A free-form tool parameter flows into a handler that executes code or shells out.

rules.name: Open tool input schema
rules.description: A tool's input schema permits additional, unvalidated properties.

rules.name: Risky parameter without validation
rules.description: A tool parameter with a dangerous name has no enum, pattern, or format constraint.

rules.name: Tool declared without an input schema
rules.description: A tool exposes parameters to the model with no schema at all.

rules.name: Dependency from a non-registry source
rules.description: A package is installed from a git ref, URL, or path rather than an immutable release.

rules.name: Floating dependencies with no lockfile
rules.description: Versions are unpinned and nothing records what was resolved, so installs can differ.

rules.name: Code executes at install time
rules.description: An npm lifecycle script runs before anyone has reviewed the package.

rules.name: Tool input reaches a shell
rules.description: A model-controlled parameter flows into a command interpreter.

rules.name: Tool input reaches a dynamic evaluator
rules.description: A model-controlled parameter flows into eval/exec/Function.

rules.name: Tool input reaches a filesystem path
rules.description: A model-controlled parameter is used as a path with no confinement to a root.

rules.name: Tool description carries instructions for the model
rules.description: A tool's description instructs the model rather than describing the tool.

rules.name: Hidden characters in tool metadata
rules.description: A tool description contains invisible or direction-overriding characters.

rules.name: Remote content returned to the model unsanitized
rules.description: A tool fetches network content and hands it straight back to the model.

rules.name: Network-exposed server without authentication
rules.description: An HTTP/SSE MCP server declares no authentication.

rules.name: Wildcard CORS origin
rules.description: The server accepts cross-origin requests from any website.

rules.name: Consequential actions are never logged
rules.description: The server executes commands or writes files and calls no logging framework at all.

rules.name: Exception swallowed silently
rules.description: An error is caught and discarded in a file that executes commands or writes files.

rules.name: Multiple server instantiations
rules.description: More than one MCP server is constructed in this codebase.

rules.name: Undeclared listening port
rules.description: Code binds a port that no manifest declares.

rules.name: Environment returned to the model
rules.description: A tool hands environment variables back to the model, where the secrets live.

rules.name: Credential file within reach of a tool
rules.description: Code touches a path holding private keys, cloud credentials, or system accounts.

rules.name: Tool operates on a filesystem root
rules.description: A file operation is rooted at `/`, a home directory, or a drive root.
